warnings: z_levels and part of the dimension chains come from the architectural sheet A-09 (รูปตัด A-A, หน้า16), outside op04's extraction scope as a page file — consulted for the grid master only per schema §4 (same decision as sibling house 51บ้าน_เล็ก_1ชั้น_16, recorded there in full).

Two dummy x-lines both anchor to main grid '1' (roof-eave line at x=-1.25 before the origin, ridge/B1 wall line at x=1.90): assigned 1' / 1'' scanning the whole axis left-to-right, per house #14's precedent. Three dummy x-lines anchor to '2': roof eave x=5.25 -> 2', landing/F2 edges x=5.35 -> 2'', x=6.65 -> 2'''. Note 2' and 2'' are only 0.10 m apart — genuinely different lines.

Dummy y-line B' at 5.90 exists because beam B1's south endpoint lands there (printed 1.90 below B on S-03); the interior beams B3 (1->2) and B2 (2->3) run along it bearing on the grid-line beams, not on columns.

Dummy y-line C' at 9.85 is the stair-landing beam B0 / footing F2 centerline: 1.35 (C to landing edge, S-02/S-03) + 0.50 (edge to pile centerline, S-05 F2 detail). The landing-slab S0 edges at y=9.35/10.35 get NO dummy (slab-only edges, §4). Unlike sibling house 16, the roof's south gable-overhang line is below row D here, so C' has no roof-edge competitor.
Dummy y-lines A' (-1.00) and D' (13.00) are the roof gable-overhang edges printed 1.00 beyond rows A and D on S-04 — อกไก่/อะเส endpoints.

The stair-landing footing F2's detail on S-05 is drawn rotated 90° relative to the building plan (detail 1.00×1.30 = building 1.30 along x × 1.00 along y); all grid positions here use building coordinates.

dummy_grid_rule_check.negative_pos_m: Two before-origin dummies: x = -1.25 (roof eave left of grid 1) and y = -1.00 (gable overhang above A); named 1'/A' with negative pos_m per house #04/#05/#14 precedent, origin stays on named grids 1/A.
dummy_grid_rule_check.prime_ordering: x-axis dummies anchored to '1': -1.25 then 1.90 -> 1', 1''. Anchored to '2': 5.25, 5.35, 6.65 -> 2', 2'', 2'''. y-axis: single dummy between B-C -> B' (5.90); single dummy between C-D -> C' (9.85); after D -> D' (13.00).
